meta.name: Qualify and route real estate leads with Gmail and Google Sheets

name: Real Estate Lead Management – Qualification, Routing & Follow-up

parameters.content:
## Real Estate Lead Management – Qualification, Routing & Follow-up


- Captures new real estate inquiries through an n8n form.
- Detects repeat inquiries using the lead phone number.
- Scores and prioritizes new leads based on budget and project timeline.
- Automatically assigns leads to the appropriate sales owner.
- Stores lead activity and status in Google Sheets.
- Sends customer confirmations and internal team notifications.
- Re-checks pending leads after configured wait periods.
- Sends follow-up reminders and escalates unattended leads to the sales manager.


## Setup Note:
- Connect your Gmail and Google Sheets credentials.
- Configure notification email addresses in the Workflow Configuration node.
- Connect your own Leads sheet using the same required column structure.

parameters.content:
## 1. Setup & Configuration













- Configure your agent and notification email addresses in the Workflow Configuration node before using this template.

- Connect your Google Sheets and Gmail credentials.

- Use the provided Leads sheet structure or connect your own sheet while keeping the required column names unchanged.

- This section captures the inquiry, loads reusable settings, and prepares standardized lead data for the workflow.

## 2. Duplicate Detection & Qualification















- Checks the incoming phone number against the lead database.
- Existing leads are routed to a repeat-inquiry notification path.
- New leads continue to qualification.
- Lead score and priority are calculated using budget and project timeline.

## 3. Lead Routing & Initial Actions















- Merges the prepared lead data with the calculated qualification results.
- Assigns the lead to the appropriate sales owner based on priority and service.
- Saves the complete lead record to Google Sheets.
- Sends an automatic confirmation email to the customer.
- Notifies the assigned real estate team member with lead details.

## 4. Follow-up & Status Monitoring















- Waits before checking whether the assigned lead has been contacted.
- Reads the latest lead status from Google Sheets using the Lead ID.
- If the status is still New Lead, the workflow continues to follow-up.
- Sends a reminder to the assigned sales agent for pending leads.
- Contacted leads exit this follow-up path automatically.

## 5. Escalation & Manager Alert














- Waits before performing a second status check.
- Re-checks the latest lead status using the Lead ID.
- Only leads that are still uncontacted continue to escalation.
- Prepares the escalation level and timestamp.
- Updates the lead record in Google Sheets as Escalated.
- Sends a detailed escalation alert to the sales manager.
